generations.memory_31: For SMBs, simplifying signup is a validated way to increase acquisition and activation: signups rose 15%, activation 9%, and qualified revenue 4%. It did not materially improve 30-day retention (-1%), and the result should not be generalized beyond SMBs.
generations.memory_44: For enterprise, a sales-assisted CTA can improve lead quality and revenue while reducing signup volume. It lowered signups 12% but increased qualified leads 24% and qualified revenue 18%, with no change in 30-day retention; do not generalize beyond enterprise.
generations.memory_57: Referral incentives are effective for established accounts, particularly those older than six months. In that group, they increased referral starts 21%, qualified revenue 7%, and 30-day retention 2%; avoid assuming the same effect for newer accounts.
generations.memory_73: Targeted 40% discounts can produce strong short-term acquisition among price-sensitive SMBs—signups rose 31% and qualified revenue 18%—but the resulting cohorts are low durability: 30-day retention fell 12% and customers did not survive the first renewal.
